title: Opting Out of Generative AI: a Behavioral Experiment on the Role of Education in Perplexity AI Avoidance

bias_targets.methodology: Conducting an online behavioral experiment to measure task avoidance rates (attrition or disengagement) when participants are assigned to use a Conversational AI tool (Perplexity AI), and analyzing disparities in avoidance across different levels of formal education using logistic regression and structural equation modeling.
Analyzing the interaction between participants' age and their likelihood of avoiding a Conversational AI task during the online behavioral experiment.
Evaluating differences in Conversational AI task avoidance rates between men and women using data gathered from the online behavioral experiment.
